title: Jesus Teaches About Divorce and Eunuchs
description: Pharisees put Jesus to the test with a question about divorce. Jesus points to the Creator's original plan: man and woman shall be one flesh, and what God has joined together must not be separated. He explains that Moses permitted divorce because of people's hard hearts, but says that anyone who divorces for any reason other than sexual immorality and marries another commits adultery. When the disciples react, Jesus speaks about three kinds of eunuchs, including those who make themselves eunuchs for the sake of the kingdom of heaven.
